// ADR-284 §7a acceptance set — plants rebuilt in the builder, generated by packages/shared/src/codeView/generate.ts.
// Golden output of apps/builder/src/preview/catalog/__tests__/adr284CodeView.test.tsx (UPDATE_CODE_VIEW=1 rewrites).

import {useState} from 'react';
import {useCollator, useFilter} from 'react-aria';
import {Button, Cell, Checkbox, Collection, Column, GridList, GridListItem, IllustratedMessage, Row, SearchField, Table, Tag, TagGroup, Text, type Selection, type SortDescriptor} from 'react-aria-components';
import {Slot} from '@composition/code';
import plants from './data/plants';

export default function Home() {
  let [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  let [favorite, setFavorite] = useState(false);
  let [cycles, setCycles] = useState<Selection>(new Set());
  let [sunlight, setSunlight] = useState<Selection>(new Set());
  let [watering, setWatering] = useState<Selection>(new Set());
  let [sortDescriptor, setSortDescriptor] = useState<SortDescriptor>();
  let {contains} = useFilter({sensitivity: 'base'});
  let collator = useCollator();
  let sortDescriptorDir = sortDescriptor?.direction === 'descending' ? -1 : 1;
  let items = plants
    .filter(item =>
      (contains(String(item.common_name), search) || item.scientific_name.some(x => contains(String(x), search))) &&
      (!favorite || item.isFavorite === true) &&
      (cycles === 'all' || cycles.size === 0 || cycles.has(item.cycle)) &&
      (sunlight === 'all' || sunlight.size === 0 || sunlight.has(item.sunlight)) &&
      (watering === 'all' || watering.size === 0 || watering.has(item.watering)))
    .toSorted((a, b) => sortDescriptor ? collator.compare(String(a[sortDescriptor.column]), String(b[sortDescriptor.column])) * sortDescriptorDir : 0);
  let itemsApplied = [{id: 'row-1', applied: [search !== '', favorite, !(cycles === 'all' || cycles.size === 0), !(sunlight === 'all' || sunlight.size === 0), !(watering === 'all' || watering.size === 0)].filter(Boolean).length}];

  return (
    <>
      <SearchField label="common_name" value={search} onChange={setSearch} />
      <Checkbox isSelected={favorite} onChange={setFavorite}>isFavorite</Checkbox>
      <TagGroup label="cycle" selectedKeys={cycles} onSelectionChange={setCycles}>
        <Slot name="Tags">
          <Tag id="Perennial" overrides={{
            'icon': {hidden: true},
            'text': {children: 'Perennial'},
          }} />
          <Tag id="Annual" overrides={{
            'icon': {hidden: true},
            'text': {children: 'Annual'},
          }} />
          <IllustratedMessage overrides={{
            'illustration': {iconName: 'folder-open'},
          }} />
        </Slot>
      </TagGroup>
      <TagGroup label="sunlight" selectedKeys={sunlight} onSelectionChange={setSunlight}>
        <Slot name="Tags">
          <Tag id="full sun" overrides={{
            'icon': {hidden: true},
            'text': {children: 'full sun'},
          }} />
          <Tag id="part shade" overrides={{
            'icon': {hidden: true},
            'text': {children: 'part shade'},
          }} />
          <IllustratedMessage overrides={{
            'illustration': {iconName: 'folder-open'},
          }} />
        </Slot>
      </TagGroup>
      <TagGroup label="watering" selectedKeys={watering} onSelectionChange={setWatering}>
        <Slot name="Tags">
          <Tag id="Frequent" overrides={{
            'icon': {hidden: true},
            'text': {children: 'Frequent'},
          }} />
          <Tag id="Average" overrides={{
            'icon': {hidden: true},
            'text': {children: 'Average'},
          }} />
          <IllustratedMessage overrides={{
            'illustration': {iconName: 'folder-open'},
          }} />
        </Slot>
      </TagGroup>
      <Text>{`${itemsApplied.find(row => row.id === 'row-1')?.applied ?? ''}`}</Text>
      <Table sortDescriptor={sortDescriptor} onSortChange={setSortDescriptor}>
        <Slot name="Columns">
          <Column>
            <Checkbox slot="selection">{``}</Checkbox>
          </Column>
          <Column key="name" allowsSorting={true}>Name</Column>
          <Column key="type" allowsSorting={true}>Type</Column>
          <Column key="status" allowsSorting={true}>Status</Column>
        </Slot>
        <Slot name="Rows">
          <Collection items={items}>
            {item => (
              <Row id={item.id} textValue={String(item.common_name)}>
                <Cell>
                  <Checkbox slot="selection" />
                </Cell>
                <Cell>{`${item?.name ?? ''}`}</Cell>
                <Cell>{`${item?.type ?? ''}`}</Cell>
                <Cell>{`${item?.status ?? ''}`}</Cell>
              </Row>
            )}
          </Collection>
        </Slot>
      </Table>
      <GridList items={items}>
        {item => (
          <GridListItem id={item.id} textValue={String(item.common_name)} />
        )}
      </GridList>
      <Button label="Clear filters" onPress={() => {
        setFavorite(false);
        setCycles(new Set());
        setSunlight(new Set());
        setWatering(new Set());
      }} />
    </>
  );
}
